label: Relocations (historical)
purpose: Hotel bookings relocated (walked) from the booked hotel to a replacement hotel, with sales, cost, profit and guests of both sides. Only 34 relocations (2015, 2021, 2022), several on test hotels; data stops in 2022 — never use it for recent periods.
grain: One relocated booking: the original (origin) booking paired with its replacement (destination) booking.
use_for: original vs replacement booking sales, cost and profit
which hotels, chains or star categories relocated guests, and where to

coverage.note: Very sparse historical data: 34 relocations in 9 months only (13 in January–March 2015, 19 in April–September 2021, 2 in August 2022), none since. Sales and cost amounts are filled for only a few 2021 relocations, and several rows use test hotels and suppliers.

rules: Historical, very small cube (34 relocations, 2015–2022): never use it for periods after August 2022, and say how few rows there are when answering.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.
List every breakdown column together with its needs_columns (group-with helper columns).
Origin = the original booking and hotel; Dest/Destination = the replacement. Never add origin and destination amounts together.
[% Total Profit Origin] is profit ÷ cost of the original booking (markup), not ÷ sales.
[Booking Window Origin] returns the largest booking window in days, not an average or a sum.
Several relocations use test hotels and suppliers; say so when listing hotels or suppliers.
'Booking Date'[Month] and 'Arrival Date Origin'[Month Origin] are month numbers without the year.
